title: Braised Fennel and Brazilian Steak Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl dish featuring tender braised fennel and grilled Brazilian steak.

ingredients.name: Brazilian Steak (1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: such as flank steak or skirt steak

instructions: Season steak with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
In a large bowl, toss sliced fennel with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a large skillet, cook fennel over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
Slice grilled steak against the grain.
To assemble bowls, place cooked fennel in the bottom, then top with sliced steak.
